verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs say you can build private integrations for systems it does not already integrate with, including on-premise and homegrown systems. A documented flow pushes custom resources from a homegrown app and turns them into pass/fail evidence with a Custom Test, and the API also attaches evidence files to documents. missing for 10: endpoint-level reference docs for the custom-resource push API in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of building such an integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover

citations.quote: Build private integrations for systems that Vanta does not already integrate with, including on-premise or homegrown systems.
Push user accounts and custom resources from a homegrown app into Vanta, then turn that data into pass/fail evidence with a Custom Test.
The Vanta API lets you automate evidence collection and testing across a wide range of system categories
Attach an evidence file to a Vanta document and submit it for review, using the Manage Vanta API.
